skills.description: Generate SAP business process swimlane diagrams from a natural-language business scenario. This skill should be used when a user describes an SAP business process (procurement, sales, production, subcontracting, STO/cross-company, intercompany, MM/PP/SD/FI flows, etc.) and wants it turned into a process diagram, flowchart, swimlane, or 流程图. It converts the scenario into correct SAP document flow: transaction codes (Txxx), movement types (e.g. 101/641/541), special stock, and intercompany settlement, and renders a self-contained HTML file with a pure-CSS swimlane (departments as columns, steps as rows) plus a step-by-step table. No Mermaid / no external CDN, so it renders correctly on any platform. The generated HTML can also be exported to editable Word (.docx) and PowerPoint (.pptx) via the bundled conversion scripts.
